The ECML is now open

The East Coast Mainline (ECML), the first line in Harlonian National's railway network, is open, bringing the City of Harlon closer to the Sealand region and the City of Victoria with new regional and intercity trains. There's more than just better connectivity, though - the ECML brings new, well-paid job opportunities. Become a Train Driver or Signaller today!

Learn more about the ECML || View ECML job opportunities
